what: Several video strips sit side by side horizontally. Only the current strip opens to 92vw while the others fold to 6vw and stay at the side. The four videos in a strip play in turn, and 1 second before one ends the next is switched on over it (1s power4.out). When the strip’s last video ends, the next strip opens in 1.4s power2.inOut. Clicking a folded strip opens it in 1.4s power2.out and restarts from its first video. It starts on a random strip, and the whole board floats up in 1.6s. If images replace videos, they advance every data-dur seconds
ease: power2.inOut (automatic) · power2.out (by hand) · power4.out (video overlap) · power2.out (first rise)

options.shut-sp: Folded strip width on phones (767px and below), falls back to shut if unset
options.fade: Overlap length in seconds when the next video fades in, also how many seconds before the end it starts, default 1
options.intro: Initial rise duration (s), 0 means immediate, default 1.6
options.ease: Curve of the strip when it advances on its own, default power2.inOut
options.hand-ease: Band curve on press, default power2.out

use: …
note: Panels are placed by the consuming side in a display:flex row. The clip (video) always sits at the panel center at its expanded width, so when folded only the center remains. The current panel gets is-current, the current video gets is-current, and the video that just ended gets is-before. Videos pause when they go off screen

from.where: index.html .h-hero — original .Hero (Hero.js: 92vw/6vw, changeCurrentSlide 1.4s power2.inOut, changeCurrentSlideByHand 1.4s power2.out, fadeTime 1 power4.out, panel opacity 1.6s power2.out)
